[[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]] is a [[mission]] [[outpost]]. It is the fortress-like capital city of the Deldrimor Dwarves.

==Getting There==
*The mission [[Iron Mines of Moladune]] will bring you here.

==Mission==
*[[Thunderhead Keep]]
**This mission is the twenty-second mission in the [[Prophecies campaign]] and the third and final mission in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks ]] region.
